items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: they would do seven days a week all over the midwest, for this Tom Archer.

ctx.x: Lawrence Welk had a band in 1933?

Oh, yes. Yes. He was the biggest thing -- it was his ace in the hole out there. I remember it was '33 or '34. I went back the next year, they had those long trailers and he was the first person to put thousands of dollars in a big trailer, and they lived in it -- his six-piece orchestra, and they would do seven days a week all over the midwest, for this Tom Archer. And I remember we were flabbergasted, they had showers in there, they had bunks -- and I heard at that time that he paid his men $75 a week, and that…
Oh, I agree. I was in California in 1933.
